description: Pull attorney records from Lawyer Legion by state/city/county and practice area, by name/firm keyword, or from profile and directory URLs.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. Miami or saint-petersburg. Narrows directory browsing and supplies the keyword-search location when Location is empty.
city.title: City (optional)

county.description: County slug as used in Lawyer Legion directory URLs, e.g. los-angeles-county or orleans-parish. Used for directory browsing when City is empty.
county.title: County (optional)

enrichProfiles.description: Adds biography, résumé, bar licenses, education, work experience, badges, photos, social profiles and review summary. One extra request per attorney.
enrichProfiles.title: Open every profile page for full details

firmName.description: Law firm name to search for, e.g. Smith Law.
firmName.title: Firm name (keyword search)

firstName.description: Attorney first name. Combine with last name, firm, practice area or location.
firstName.title: First name (keyword search)

includeReviews.description: Fetch each attorney's reviews page and add every published review (title, rating, date, author, type, text). Adds one extra request per reviewed attorney.
includeReviews.title: Include full review texts

location.description: City, state or ZIP, e.g. Miami, FL or 33101. Leave empty to search nationwide.
location.title: Location (keyword search)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on records emitted. 0 means up to 10,000.
maxItems.title: Max attorneys

mode.description: Choose how to find attorneys: browse the directory, search by name/firm/location, or paste URLs.
enumTitles: Browse directory by state, city or county
Search by name, firm or location
Scrape profile or directory URLs
mode.title: Scrape mode

partitionByCity.description: When a state+practice listing stops at Lawyer Legion's 250-row cap, also crawl the state's city and county pages for more unique attorneys. Turn off to keep runs short.
partitionByCity.title: Partition capped state slices by city/county

practiceArea.description: Directory category or board-certification specialty. Use 'any' only with a city/county in directory mode, or in keyword search.
